title: 10 Things a Firefighter Would NEVER Leave Plugged In at Night
description:
📘 Get my full home fire-safety guide to protect your family and avoid costly fire damage before a small hazard turns into a devastating house fire → https://www.frederickbarnesbooks.com/

Prevent The Burning: 101 Tricks, Methods and Lessons from House Fires That Didn't Have To Happen — practical, homeowner-friendly fire-safety lessons for anyone who wants to protect their home and family, written from decades of real-world experience. On sale now for a limited time.

What electrical devices should you never leave plugged in overnight? In this video, we reveal 10 common household items that can pose unnecessary electrical and fire risks when left connected to power, along with simple habits that can help make your home safer. Learn practical fire safety tips, electrical safety advice, home safety tips, fire prevention, electrical hazards, appliance safety, and nighttime safety habits that every homeowner and renter should know. From overloaded outlets and damaged chargers to heat-producing appliances and other everyday electronics, discover what to check before going to bed and how to reduce potential risks. Whether you’re looking for firefighter safety tips, home fire prevention, electrical safety tips, energy-saving habits, or ways to protect your family and home, this guide provides simple, practical information to help you create a safer nighttime routine.
